name: Nimastra (Neem Astra - 5% Solution)
purpose: Controlling sucking pests (Aphids, Jassids, Thrips, Whiteflies) and early-stage small caterpillars
steps: Mix crushed neem leaves, cow urine, and cow dung in 100L water in a plastic drum
Stir clockwise twice a day for 48 hours in the shade
Strain through a thin cloth
Spray directly without dilution (100L/acre) using a knapsack sprayer

name: Agniastra (Fire Extract)
purpose: Controlling stubborn caterpillars (Pod borers, Pink bollworms, Leaf rollers, Stem borers)
steps: Combine all ingredients in a copper/earthen pot or steel vessel
Boil on low heat for 15 minutes, cool, let sit for 48 hours
Filter using a cloth
Mix 2-3 Liters in 100 Liters water per acre

name: Dashparni Ark (10-Leaf Extract)
purpose: Broad-spectrum bio-pesticide against all chewing, biting, and sucking insects
ingredients: Leaves of 10 local plants (2 kg each): Neem, Custard Apple, Papaya, Castor, Guduchi, Lantana, Pongamia, Calotropis, Nerium, Bael
steps: Mix all in a 200L drum
Cover with cloth, ferment 30-40 days (stir daily)
Strain
Mix 6 Liters in 200 Liters water/acre. Storeable up to 6 months

name: NSKE 5% (Neem Seed Kernel Extract)
purpose: Anti-feedant, insect growth regulator, egg disruptor for Bollworms, Spodoptera, Mites, Thrips
steps: Soak 5kg crushed neem seed powder in 10L water overnight
Squeeze through cloth to collect clear light-brown liquid
Dilute with 90L water, add 200g soap as sticker
Spray immediately on foliage

name: Brahmastra (5-Leaf Extract)
purpose: Control of medium-sized caterpillars, sucking pests, and leaf miners
steps: Mix leaves with cow urine, boil 20 minutes
Keep covered 48 hours, strain
Mix 2.5-3 Liters in 100 Liters water

name: Tikhat-Lasun Ark (Chilli, Garlic & Ginger Spray)
purpose: Fast knockdown spray against Aphids, Jassids, Thrips, Spider Mites
steps: Blend chilli, garlic, ginger with 2L water, soak overnight
Filter out solids
Add soap water, dilute to 100 Liters
Spray thoroughly morning or late evening

name: Tambe-Tak / Khadat Tak Spray (Copper-Fermented Buttermilk)
purpose: Organic fungicide for Powdery Mildew, Downy Mildew, Leaf Spots, Bacterial Blight, Citrus Canker
steps: Place sour buttermilk in earthen pot, immerse copper wire/vessel
Cover, ferment 10-15 days until milk turns greenish-blue
Remove copper wire, dilute 5L in 100L water, spray

name: Wood Ash & Lime Dusting
purpose: Repelling Flea beetles, Cutworms, Ants, Caterpillars; suppressing fungal spores
steps: Mix dry wood ash and slaked lime thoroughly
Dust directly onto morning dew-drenched crop leaves

name: Tobacco Extract (Nikotin Spray)
purpose: Eradicating hardy caterpillars, mealybugs, and thrips
warning: Avoid on Solanaceous family (Tomato/Potato) due to Tobacco Mosaic Virus risk
steps: Boil tobacco powder in 10L water for 30 min
Strain, dilute to 100L water with soap

name: Jeevamrut (Liquid Bio-Fertilizer / Microbe Culture)
purpose: Multiplies soil beneficial microbes, fixes Nitrogen, solubilizes Phosphorus & Potassium, enhances root growth
steps: Mix all in 200L water in shaded drum
Stir clockwise 5 min twice daily for 5-7 days
Apply 200L/acre via drip, drenching, or flood irrigation every 15-20 days

name: Beejamrut (Organic Seed Treatment Culture)
purpose: Protects seeds/seedlings against soil-borne fungal diseases (Fusarium wilt, Root rot) and promotes germination
steps: Mix cow dung tied in cloth in 20L water overnight, squeeze liquid
Add urine, milk, lime water, soil, stir well
Smear over seeds before sowing, air-dry 30 min, sow immediately

name: Hing-Halad Ark (Asafoetida & Turmeric Bio-Fungicide)
steps: Dissolve asafoetida in 1L warm water overnight
Mix turmeric into 2L milk
Combine both into 100L water
Spray to prevent Powdery/Downy Mildew, Leaf Curl Virus, Bacterial Spot

name: Sonth-Doodh Ark (Ginger Powder & Milk Bio-Fungicide)
steps: Boil ginger powder in 2L water till reduced to 1L, cool
Boil milk separately, cool, remove cream
Mix both into 100L water
Spray within 24 hrs of preparation

name: Karanj-Neem Extract
steps: Soak crushed Karanj and Neem in 5L cow urine for 5 days
Filter, dilute into 100L water
Spray on foliage or drench near roots
